runtime_reviews.sports_federation_accounting/models/fina: Locks the finance event row by parameterized primary key before invoice creation; the native invoice test verifies retry idempotency.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_competition_core/model: Clears optional internal restrict links with table and field identifiers taken from the ORM registry and record IDs passed as parameters before guarded records are removed.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_duty_coverage/models/a: Locks match, referee, and assignment rows in stable ID order to serialize assignment and evidence transitions; persisted coverage tests exercise these commands.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_duty_coverage/models/c: Locks match rows by parameterized ID before computing and syncing escalation activities; escalation tests verify replay and cleanup.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_duty_coverage/models/d: Locks matches and duty rows in stable order before nomination and coordinator transitions; duty workflow tests cover the state changes.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_duty_coverage/wizards/: Locks the resolution wizard and referee rows before applying a preview; coverage tests verify stale-preview rejection and replay safety.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_live_workspace/models/: Uses parameterized shared row locks on court access and the live session while validating command scope; tests cover revoked access and closed sessions.
Locks the visual proposal row before applying its revision-bound command; visual planning tests verify one-time application and identical replay.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_base/models/operation_: Locks the source row by its validated table identifier and primary key before enqueueing, and claims jobs with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED so two workers never run the same job; job-claiming tests cover concurrent claims.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_calendar/models/matchd: Locks the match-day row by parameterized primary key before an audited event-timezone review so two reviewers cannot both change it; slot instants are not touched.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_finance_bridge/models/: Locks finance event rows in stable ID order before state transitions so retries and concurrent confirmations cannot create duplicate handoffs.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_live_workspace/models/: Locks the schedule row by parameterized primary key so constraint edits, preview generation and application share one serialized schedule revision.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_notifications/models/a: Takes a transaction-scoped advisory lock per communication key so the same actionable message is published at most once under concurrent triggers.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_accounting/models/club: Locks the club season registration row by parameterized primary key before creating its invoice, so two invoice runs cannot both bill the same uninvoiced player charges.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_notifications/models/c: Locks the sendable mail rows in stable ID order before recording delivery attempts, so concurrent senders cannot double-count or double-send one mail.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_notifications/models/n: Selects owned, finished mail for retention with parameterized SQL and claims each row with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED before deletion; also creates a partial index in init().
Locks the mail row before the notification log with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, matching the transport's update order to avoid deadlocks and double processing.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_people/models/club_sea: Locks club season registration rows in stable ID order before adding, submitting, approving or cancelling players, so concurrent approvals cannot activate or bill a licence twice.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_portal/models/task_pro: Takes transaction-scoped advisory try-locks per club in sorted order while rebuilding the task projection, so concurrent rebuilds of the same scope skip instead of conflicting.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_registration/models/pa: Locks the division and then the registration window rows in stable ID order before finalizing entries, serializing windows that target the same division.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_schedule_approval/mode: Locks the game-day row by parameterized primary key before a reviewed reschedule, so it is applied only against the expected live publication.
runtime_reviews.sports_federation_schedule_approval/serv: Locks the game-day row by parameterized primary key before publishing, so concurrent publications cannot both replace the live publication.
